description: EVM DeFi agent for SVP-Chain: swap quoting and building, bridge deposits, ERC-20/ERC-721 transfers and approvals, raw EVM broadcast, self-service auth, and faucet. Every state-changing EVM payload is signed by the caller locally before broadcast.
name: svpchain-evm-agent

skills.description: Wallet-signature authentication: auth_challenge issues a challenge bound to an owner address, auth_verify checks the wallet's signature and mints a bearer token that authenticates subsequent calls (Authorization header, envelope field, or bound to this A2A context). Tools: auth_challenge, auth_verify.
skills.name: SVP-Chain Self-Service Auth

skills.description: Testnet faucet: list claimable tokens and claim them to an address. Tools: faucet_claim, list_faucet_tokens.
skills.name: SVP-Chain Faucet

skills.description: EVM-side operations: list configured stable ERC-20 aliases with list_evm_assets; discover current Uniswap V2 pairs from the configured Factory with list_swap_pairs, then quote_swap before building a swap; the deployment does not maintain a static Pair list. Also broadcasts raw txs and tracks status, builds bridge deposits (outbound and inbound from registered foreign chains), and builds ERC-20/ERC-721 transfers and approvals. Served only when the deployment configures the EVM endpoints. Tools: broadcast_evm_tx, build_bridge_deposit, build_bridge_deposit_inbound, build_erc20_approve, build_erc20_transfer, build_erc20_transfer_from, build_erc721_approve, build_erc721_safe_transfer_from, build_erc721_set_approval_for_all, build_erc721_transfer_from, build_swap, build_token_approval, evm_tx_status, list_evm_assets, list_swap_pairs, quote_swap.
skills.name: SVP-Chain EVM
